reasoning.text: Decelerate to navigate the narrow passage between the parked vehicle and the roadside barrier on the right.
Decelerate to come to a stop along the right edge of the roadway to yield to the pedestrian walking in the roadway ahead.
Stop and yield to the oncoming scooter rider in the narrow roadway, as the narrow roadway ahead is obstructed.
Decelerate to a stop to yield to the oncoming vehicle approaching through the narrow roadway ahead.
Decelerate and turn right into the commercial entrance to enter the property, as the driveway is clear.
Steer right and decelerate to pull over along the right curb, as the roadside parking area is clear.
Slow down and steer right to pull over and stop alongside the curb, as we have reached our destination.
